decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the paperback publication format and PAPERBACK context, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Confirming paperback publication does not change the existing back-matter or author-copy obligations, which are already scoped to PAPERBACK.
The manuscript was already explicitly being prepared for paperback publication, and the format confirmation does not change its copyediting rules or approved passages.
The paperback confirmation does not necessarily change the chapter illustration coverage, placement, image assignments, or review criteria.
The publication-format confirmation does not entail any change to the copyright-page publisher line or layout.
The paperback confirmation does not alter the Chapter 12 subtitle, body-text hierarchy, or capitalization requirements.
Confirming paperback publication does not resolve the separate uncertainty about whether the interior title page should include an image.
The paperback confirmation does not change the prohibition on the unintended literal newline artifact in the book title.
